name: a Navi's companion's animation from the opening, by the fight's frames

objects.what: AquaMan's companion (kind 1) and WindMan's (kinds 2 and 3), BN4_T1_COMPANION

why: A BN4 Navi's companion's sprite state (its sprite's +0 to +0x2B: the animation, its count, flags, art and frame), the first kind's type his recipe moves (its role told by its type, tools/xdiff_snap.py T1_MOVED), until it first steps with the battle's offset. AquaMan's companion (the first kind's 0x5C, kind 1, spawned by his init at 0x080B826A, in BN6 at his spawn's end) sets its animation up in its init (0x080CCCDC, the animation setter BN4 0x08002E10, BN6 0x08002DA4), in the battle's paused opening. Its update (0x080CCD3C, run every frame by the object runner, its +0 0x04 from its spawner, 0x080CCF4A) runs its mode 8 (0x080CCE8C), which runs its kind's routine (kind 1's 0x080CCECC) and then the after-step (BN4 0x080143FC at 0x080CCEB0, unless time is stopped, 0x08007948 at 0x080CCEAA); its copy in BN6 calls the twins (BN6 0x0801BBAC and 0x0800A098, tools/bn4_twins.py), whose pause tests (BN4 0x080078EC, BN6 0x0800A03C) skip the sprite update (BN4 0x0800285C, BN6 0x080026C4) in the paused opening and run it at every fight frame from the first. So its animation runs by the fight's frames, the second clock (bn4 clocks), not by its Navi's state runner (BN4 0x08013C48, BN6 0x0801B1C4), which BN6 opens a frame later (allowed, "BN6's battle a fight frame behind BN4's"). It is set up again only from its Navi's state: kind 1's routine marks its +0xC while AquaMan's animation (his +0x10) is not 0 (0x080CCED0-0x080CCEE0) and, once it is 0 again, clears it and makes its +0x11 0xFF (0x080CCEE4-0x080CCEF0), so the after-step sets its animation up anew (0x0801442C-0x0801443E) and it follows the battle's offset from there. In aquaman_v1 its count reads 1, 0, 2, 1, 0, 2, 1, 0, 2, 1 at BN4's t1-t10 and at BN6's t1-t10, a frame ahead at the offset, and from BN4's t11 (BN6's t12), its animation set up again, the same at the offset. Compared at the same fight frame (BN6's record of BN4's t) until its sprite state is first the same at the battle's offset, exactly from then on (tools/xdiff_bn4_opening.py CompanionClock); any other difference fails the spec. FireMan's companion (0x57) copies his animation from his first state on (companion_opening_count) and is not held
